title: Google Gemini 4 Argon is now available on Unity Gateway
body:
Google [Gemini 4 Argon](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis/supported-models#gemini-4-argon) is now available on Unity Gateway. You can access this model using [Foundation Model APIs](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis).

Customers are responsible for ensuring their compliance with [applicable terms](/aws/en/machine-learning/model-serving/acceptable-use-models).
